REQ-1.description: a Workflow release is a deterministic tar.gz package plus manifest and SHA256SUMS, extracted only through a safe, manifest-exact verifier

REQ-2.description: packages come from a configurable source and are accepted only when the archive digest equals both the Manager-shipped pin and the published SHA256SUMS; a local directory holding a pinned version must match its pin; an unpinned version installs only from a local directory, as unpublished, and otherwise refuses

REQ-3.description: downloaded packages are cached, re-verified on every hit, discarded when broken, safe under concurrency, and usable offline; every install reads a private snapshot verified against the pin under the cache lock

REQ-4.description: bootstrap/update/status/verify/releases work from an installed wheel with no checkout; --release-dir for unpublished trees; --manager-root a deprecated alias; the installation record names its source

REQ-5.description: each of 2.3.1-2.6.0 is packaged and proved byte-for-byte identical to its distribution/ tree before removal, with the digests pinned and recorded

REQ-6.description: tests cover the Manager, the newest pinned release in its three fixtures and the update path from the release before it; old releases are not re-tested

REQ-7.description: distribution/, migration/, tools/migrate.py and tools/build_release.py leave the repository

REQ-8.description: the STOPGAP(M2) profile and its gate-policy exception are removed; every CI event runs the full selection

REQ-9.description: documentation and the K1-K5 cutover runbook describe packages, pins, cache and the workflow repository
